sizeBandReferenceDate.anchor: OWHS v0.2 design choice: the date the band relates to

OrgUnit.description: Organisation-scoped unit and declared headcount band. No zero band exists in the pinned vocabulary; unknown or zero is not 1-4. References and hierarchy need supplied-bundle checks.

headcountReferenceDate.privacy: not separately assigned; entity restrictions apply

WorkerPseudonym.description: Organisation-scoped pseudonym with optional banded demographics. Syntax does not prove HMAC generation, salt custody, anonymity or permission to disclose demographics.

AbsenceEpisode.description: Reported sickness-absence episode with versioned reason-category mapping. No direct identifiers.

fitNoteFlag.anchor: fit note issued (Statement of Fitness for Work)

ReturnToWorkOutcome.description: What happened after an absence, including did-not-return and ill-health-exit. No direct identifiers.

sustainedAt.codelist: codelist:rtw-sustained-status@0.1.0 (element status; the checkpoint weeks are advisory rtw-checkpoint@0.1.0)
sustainedAt.anchor: any 1 to 104 weeks; {4,13,26} recommended, provisional pending whiu:

sustainedAt[].checkpointWeeks.anchor: Founder decision 7 Jul 2026: open integer, not enum. Recommended set {4,13,26} (codelist:rtw-checkpoint@0.1.0); producers SHOULD use the recommended set for comparability. whiu: definitions expected to supersede.

sustainedAt[].status.anchor: closed vocabulary; unknown means the checkpoint was not followed up, which is not a relapse

OHEpisode.description: Management-facing envelope of an OH interaction. Carries NO clinical content.

assessmentType.anchor: management referral / health surveillance / DSE / pre-placement

fitnessOpinion.anchor: fit / unfit / fit-with-adjustments (the released opinion, per AMRA 1988 / GMC)

recommendationTypes.anchor: recommendation *types* only, shared with RTW adjustments

opinionReleasedToEmployer.anchor: consent flag; MUST be true for fitnessOpinion to be present

ReasonableAdjustment.description: Management-facing adjustment record, with sensitive disability flag restricted to the producer. Omitted endDate means no end date is recorded; null is not a date. A recorded category does not decide any legal duty or lawful disclosure.

orgId.privacy: not separately assigned; entity restrictions apply

adjustmentCategory.anchor: Equality Act 2010 s.20 duty; superset of fit-note categories

endDate.anchor: Omit when no end date is recorded; null is invalid. Use status for adjustment state.

disabilityRelated.anchor: whether tied to a disability, sensitive; aggregate via DisabilityParticipation only

BenefitEntitlement.description: Declared statutory scheme or commercial workforce benefit. No eligibility, rate or legal entitlement is computed. Statutory descriptions are dated and sourced; omitted optional terms are not zero.

statutory.anchor: closed statutory-term object; dated and sourced; no rate or eligibility is computed

statutory.rate.currency.anchor: ISO 4217 code syntax only; membership is not resolved.

statutory.rate.basis.anchor: Rate period or other calculation basis, for example per week. A variable statutory formula must be stated in description, not replaced with a fictitious fixed rate.

healthDomainTags.anchor: maps services to the same constructs measurement uses

BenefitUtilisation.description: Producer-held aggregate event counts. This is not an employer-output record: use an AggregateReport and the privacy profile for disclosure. Counts below a reporting floor can be structurally valid here. Claim contents and individual attendance are excluded.

orgId.privacy: not separately assigned; entity restrictions apply

periodStart.anchor: OWHS v0.2 design choice: inclusive reporting dates

periodEnd.anchor: OWHS v0.2 design choice: inclusive reporting dates

claimCount.anchor: Claim events, never an individual claim record. Repeated claims may exceed n.

n.anchor: distinct people represented across the recorded service-use and claim events in this period; not the whole eligible workforce and not automatically the denominator for either event category separately; a released metric requires its own distinct-person count and completion metadata in AggregateReport

DisabilityParticipation.description: Reserved-minimal producer-held organisation aggregate. No disability measure or national definition is invented. The shape has no respondent denominator or suppression metadata: this schema cannot establish the n>=10 disclosure rule and does not authorise employer or benchmark release. Zero, unknown and non-disclosure must not be recoded into 1-4.

period.anchor: Human-readable period label; periodStart and periodEnd define the inclusive dates.

disabledHeadcountBand.anchor: n≥10 floor; banded, minimal until whiu: defines the measure

MeasurementContext.description: What makes scores comparable: the producing system, the scoring descriptor and its provenance, the data window it describes, and the stated limitations. Immutable: a changed descriptor is a new context.

contextId.anchor: Primary identifier, unique within the organisation.

orgId.privacy: not separately assigned; entity restrictions apply

recallPeriod.privacy: not separately assigned; entity restrictions apply
recallPeriod.anchor: The instrument's recall period where its source specifies one, for example 'preceding two weeks'. Distinct from observationWindow.

scoringDescriptor.anchor: aggregation method / estimation family / window (open descriptor, no method enum)

scoringDescriptor.method.anchor: Scoring method, in the producer's words.

scoringDescriptor.estimand.anchor: What the score estimates: a period mean, a modelled current state, a rolling average with its window, and so on.

scoringDescriptor.observationWindow.anchor: The data the descriptor represents. Not the instrument's recall period.

scoringDescriptor.nativeScale.anchor: Bounds of the native response scale.

scoringDescriptor.normalisation.anchor: Rule that maps nativeValue to 0..100. Required by any observation carrying normalisedValue.

scoringDescriptor.normalisation.id.anchor: Identifier of the rule or table.

scoringDescriptor.normalisation.version.anchor: Version of the rule or table.

scoringDescriptor.banding.anchor: Banding table. Required by any administration carrying band.

scoringDescriptor.banding.version.anchor: Version of the rule or table.

scoringDescriptor.threshold.anchor: Threshold rule. Required by any administration carrying aboveThresholdFlag.

scoringDescriptor.threshold.id.anchor: Identifier of the rule or table.

scoringDescriptor.threshold.version.anchor: Version of the rule or table.

scoringDescriptor.missingResponseRule.anchor: Scoring rule for partial administrations. Required by any partial administration carrying scores.

scoringDescriptor.missingResponseRule.id.anchor: Identifier of the rule or table.

scoringDescriptor.missingResponseRule.ve.anchor: Version of the rule or table.

C9.statement: completionRate is n/eligibleN, null only when eligibleN is 0

C10.statement: if both dates exist, endDate >= startDate

C15.statement: n <= usageCount + claimCount (an absent claimCount contributes no recorded events); n = 0 requires both recorded event counts to be zero. Repeated events may exceed n. Declarations are compared; people are not deduplicated

C16.statement: composition.orgCount <= sampleSizes.people; observations, when supplied, >= people. Contributing organisations and people, not invited but non-contributing units

C17.statement: percentile probabilities strictly increase in array order and values never decrease; tied values and a single quantile are valid, duplicate probabilities are not; no quantile algorithm or sampling distribution is verified

C18.statement: parentUnitId, if supplied, differs from unitId; the direct self-loop only

G01.statement: every record carrying orgId equals its enclosing Organisation's orgId; the three older episodes (absence, return to work, OH) inherit the group scope for this checker only, and no field is injected into a source record

G02.statement: unique group orgId, unique scoped entity keys, unique benchmark (benchmarkId, releaseVersion); duplicates are errors even when byte-identical, with no first-wins or last-wins

G03.statement: every present declared intra-organisation reference resolves to exactly one supplied target in the enclosing group; a match in another group fails

G04.statement: ReturnToWorkOutcome and its AbsenceEpisode, OHEpisode and its optional linked AbsenceEpisode, ReasonableAdjustment and its optional source OHEpisode share one pseudonymId; both records' worker references must also resolve

G05.statement: OrgUnit parent links form an acyclic graph within each organisation, walked iteratively (C18 already catches the direct self-loop)

G06.statement: rtwDate, when present, is on or after the linked AbsenceEpisode's startDate; it is not required to follow endDate (phased return and a continuing episode are not rejected), and no date is inferred from the outcome label

G07.statement: every report benchmarkRef resolves by the exact (benchmarkId, releaseVersion) pair; another version is never substituted

G08.statement: the referenced release's measure.metricCode equals the report's metricCode; equal strings are declared identity only

G09.statement: a referenced release with leaveOneOut true names the referencing organisation as excludedOrgId; an unreferenced release's excluded organisation need not be supplied

G10.statement: comparisonAsOfDate lies within the referenced release's validFrom and validTo, inclusive; unreferenced old releases may be carried as inventory
